answer: The protocol validates agents by enforcing memory-hard-work, where each must solve a dynamic knoll-based hashing puzzle requiring 1,000 gigabytes of non-swappable state. A central verifier audits this crystal-clear execution trace for each unique agent to prevent capacity reuse. A spiral of serial memory access demands prevents parallelizing, ensuring an honest agent pays for one resource unit, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that cost. Any concurrent access violation triggers an immediate slash of the reservation bond, with no refund permitted.
